title: Story picture cards (bridge, river, meadow, goats; no faces)
subject: English
source: Seeded from english/y2 lesson 55 (Story picture cards (bridge, river, meadow, goats; no faces))
intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

parts.text: I do: think about the beginning: the goats wanted the green grass across the river.
Labelled model: Beginning: Three goats lived by a river. | Problem: A greedy troll lived under the bridge. | Ending: The big goat sent the troll away.

questions.q: S: What did the goats want at the start?
questions.a: To eat the green grass on the other side of the river
questions.model: I do: think about the beginning: the goats wanted the green grass across the river.

questions.q: I: Why did the little goats say wait for my brother?
questions.a: So the troll would let them go and wait for a bigger meal

questions.q: draw three boxes (beginning, problem, ending) and write one sentence for each
questions.a: For example: Beginning: three goats want grass. Problem: a troll lives under the bridge. Ending: the goats eat the grass.
questions.model: Labelled model: Beginning: Three goats lived by a river. | Problem: A greedy troll lived under the bridge. | Ending: The big goat sent the troll away.

questions.q: write a list of two reasons why the troll was wrong
questions.a: For example: He was greedy. He did not share the bridge.

questions.q: think of a kinder way the story could end
questions.a: For example: The troll learns to share and they all cross.
